name: drupal/civicrm_entity
description: Expose CiviCRM entities as Drupal entities.

suggest.drupal/ds: Required by the optional CiviCRM Entity Display Suite integration.
suggest.drupal/field_group: Required by the optional CiviCRM Entity Field Group integration.
suggest.drupal/fullcalendar_view: Required to run the optional Fullcalendar View integration tests on a supported Drupal version.
suggest.drupal/rules: Required by the optional CiviCRM Entity Rules integration.
suggest.drupal/search_api: Required by the optional CiviCRM Entity Search API integration.
suggest.drupal/typed_data: Required by the optional CiviCRM Entity Rules integration.
suggest.drupal/views_bulk_operations: Required by the optional CiviCRM Entity VBO integration.
